content: कर्परः .²1 An iron sauce-pan, a frying-pan. .²2 A pot or vessel in general (as of a potter). .²3 A pot-sherd, piece of a broken jar; as in घटकर्पर; जीयेय येन कविना यमकैः परेण तस्मै वहेयमुदकं घटकर्परेण <ls>Ghaṭ. 22</ls>. .²4 The skull. .²5 A kind of weapon. .²6 A back-bone; न्यञ्चत्कर्परकूर्म <ls>Māl. 5. 22</ls>. .{@-रम्@} A pot, pot-sherd.
